text: The owned cleanup removes get_repository and comments its unused local assignments with a TODO. It leaves the then-current default/tip base assignments unchanged. At the fixed accepted revision, repo is active again for commit text, default-branch fallback and merge-base calculation; merge-base errors retain the supplied revision. Treat the cleanup as a phase-specific removal of an unused handle, not proof the repository API is unnecessary or that parameter behavior and taskgraph validation were fully repaired.
title: An unused decision repository handle was disabled temporarily and later gained real consumers
